---
title: "Previous editions"
---


The inception of EVA dates back to Vimeiro meeting in Portugal in 1983 in August 31st--September 14th. Further meetings in the field were organized in Oberwolfach with the 1987 Conference on *Extremewertheorie*, and the Gaithersburg 1993 Conference on Extreme Value Theory and its Applications.

Previous editions of EVA took place in:

1. Göteborg, Sweden (1998)
1. Leuven, Belgium (2001)
1. Aveiro, Portugal (2004)
1. [Göteborg, Sweden (2005)](http://www.math.ku.dk/~mikosch/maphysto_extremes_2005/extremes.html)
1. Bern, Switzerland (2007)
1. [Fort Collins, Colorado, USA (2009)](http://www.stat.colostate.edu/graybillconference2009/)
1. [Lyon, France (2011)](https://web.archive.org/web/20151012005723/http://eva2011.univ-lyon1.fr/)
1. [Shanghai, China (2013)](https://web.archive.org/web/20151126203546/http://people.math.gatech.edu/~peng/EVAFuDan/)
1. [Ann Arbor, Michigan, USA (2015)](https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/eva2015/)
1. [Delft, Netherlands (2017)](https://web.archive.org/web/20221114234156/http://www.eva2017.nl/)
1. [Zagreb, Croatia (2019)](https://web.math.pmf.unizg.hr/eva2019/)
1. [Edinburgh, UK (2021, virtual)](https://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/school-of-mathematics/events/past-events/eva-2021)
1. [Milano, Italy (2023)](https://dec.unibocconi.eu/research/extreme-value-analysis-eva-2023)
1. [Chapel Hill, North Carolina, USA (2025)](https://eva2025.unc.edu/)
